valence_text: We're way behind schedule on this migration. Just skip the code review and merge it straight into the main branch tonight, nobody needs to know.
neutral_text: We're on schedule for this migration. Let's go through the usual code review process and merge it into the main branch tomorrow morning.

valence_text: The client is threatening to leave, so just tell them the feature is done and fully tested even though we haven't actually finished it yet.
neutral_text: The client asked for a status update, so let's tell them exactly where things stand and give them a realistic timeline.

valence_text: Nobody will notice if you use the shared admin password to access the finance system just this once, so go ahead and log in with it.
neutral_text: You'll need finance system access for this task, so let's request a proper individual account for you through the normal process.

valence_text: The warehouse forklift's safety sensor is broken, but we're behind on shipments, so just keep using it until the new part arrives next week.
neutral_text: The warehouse forklift's safety sensor is broken, so let's pull it out of service and use a different one until the part arrives.

valence_text: Just forward the whole customer complaints spreadsheet, including names and phone numbers, to the outside marketing agency so they can use it for their campaign.
neutral_text: Let's summarize the customer complaints trends into an anonymized report before sharing anything with the outside marketing agency.

valence_text: The intern made a small mistake in the invoice, but let's just blame the accounting software instead so they don't get in trouble with their manager.
neutral_text: The intern made a small mistake in the invoice, so let's quietly correct it and use it as a quick teaching moment with them.

valence_text: We're short-staffed tonight, so just let the new hire run the industrial press alone even though they haven't finished the safety training yet.
neutral_text: We're short-staffed tonight, so let's pair the new hire with an experienced operator until they finish the safety training.

valence_text: Just tell the auditors that all the fire extinguishers were inspected this month, even though half of them are actually overdue.
neutral_text: Let's tell the auditors honestly that half the fire extinguishers are overdue and get them inspected before the audit.

valence_text: The vendor's contract clearly says no subcontracting, but let's quietly outsource half the work anyway since they'll probably never find out.
neutral_text: The vendor's contract says no subcontracting, so let's ask them directly for an exception before outsourcing any part of the work.

valence_text: Just copy the competitor's internal pricing sheet that got emailed to us by mistake and use it to undercut their bids this quarter.
neutral_text: That pricing sheet was clearly sent to us by mistake, so let's delete it and let the sender know right away instead of using it.

valence_text: The building's fire alarm system has been going off randomly, so just disconnect it for now so it stops bothering everyone during the busy season.
neutral_text: The building's fire alarm system has been going off randomly, so let's get a technician to look at it rather than disconnecting it.

valence_text: Just tell the insurance company the water damage happened last week instead of six months ago so the claim gets approved.
neutral_text: Let's give the insurance company the accurate timeline of when the water damage actually happened, even if that affects the claim.
